companyProfile.coverageRegionAlicanteProvinceHelp: Alicante province / Costa Blanca (Benidorm, Elche, Torrevieja…). Not Valencia city.
companyProfile.coverageRegionMadridCommunityHelp: Madrid city plus a few major/tourist towns (Alcalá, Aranjuez, El Escorial). Not every municipality. Madrid Airport is a separate extra city.
companyProfile.coverageRegionCostaDelSolHelp: Málaga city plus a few nearby towns (Marbella, Torremolinos, Fuengirola).
companyProfile.extraCitiesHelp: Tick a single city (Barcelona, Valencia, Madrid…) and/or extra towns. Community switches below add the rest of that pack.
companyProfile.radiusComplementHelp: Use the radius alone, or together with cities.

deliveryZonesPage.title: Delivery & Pricing
deliveryZonesPage.formulaHint: Each side is one way from base. <bold>Delivery (pickup)</bold> and <bold>return (collection)</bold> are priced separately and added together.
deliveryZonesPage.fixedPriceHelper: Leave empty for dynamic price from the formula
deliveryZonesPage.locationDenied: Location permission denied. Allow location access or enter coordinates manually.
deliveryZonesPage.baseHelper: Distances are driving km from this base to each city (Google). Fixed and free prices stay unchanged.
deliveryZonesPage.distancesRecalculated: Updated {{count}} distances from the new base.
deliveryZonesPage.summaryInside: Inside (≤ {{km}} km): {{price}} per side (delivery and return each)
deliveryZonesPage.summaryInsideNoRadius: Inside (set radius to activate): {{price}} per side
deliveryZonesPage.summaryAfterHours: After hours: +€{{amount}} on each side outside working hours
deliveryZonesPage.radiusHelp: Addresses within this radius from your office use the inside rule. Empty = rules inactive (legacy zones / €/km only).
deliveryZonesPage.insideModeHelp: Two options for addresses inside the circle: a fixed fee (same price no matter the km), or € per km from the office.
deliveryZonesPage.outsideModeHelp: Beyond the circle: € per km past the radius, one fixed fee, or block (except listed outside zones).
deliveryZonesPage.insideFixedHelp: One fixed amount for the whole circle — distance inside does not change the price (0 = free).
deliveryZonesPage.insidePerKmHelp: Distance from your office × this rate.
deliveryZonesPage.outsideFixedHelp: One fixed amount for any address outside the radius.
deliveryZonesPage.outsidePerKmHelp: Charged on km beyond the service radius
deliveryZonesPage.diagramAria: Diagram of office, service radius, and inside versus outside pricing
deliveryZonesPage.diagramLead: Your office is the center. We measure driving distance from it. Set a service radius to split pricing into inside and outside.
deliveryZonesPage.diagramOptionFixedBody: one flat fee for any drop-off within the circle — 5 km or 25 km costs the same (e.g. €25).
deliveryZonesPage.diagramOptionPerKmBody: price = distance from the office × your rate (no flat fee).
deliveryZonesPage.diagramOutsideNote: Outside the circle you can charge €/km only for the km beyond the radius, a fixed fee, or block delivery (except listed outside zones).
deliveryZonesPage.outsideZonesHelp: Optional named places outside the default area (airport, another city). Google distance decides inside vs outside — you do not need every suburb here. If outside mode is “blocked”, only these exceptions are allowed.
deliveryZonesPage.afterHoursHelp: When pickup time is outside working hours, the surcharge is added to delivery. When return time is outside hours, it is added to collection. Both can apply.
deliveryZonesPage.bothSidesHint: Rules apply to both car delivery and car collection. Different addresses or after-hours on one side only change that side.
deliveryZonesPage.operatingCitiesHelp: Addresses inside these cities are free (or flat fee). Outside → €/km from the office.
deliveryZonesPage.maxDistanceHelp: Beyond this distance from the office, delivery is blocked / contact us.

forBusiness.title: rovaro as a rental platform
forBusiness.intro: Put your fleet online: customers book on the website, and you run day-to-day operations from one admin panel — from the first request to the return.
forBusiness.cta: Talk to us about the platform

notifications.title: Instant notifications
notifications.text: As soon as a customer places a booking, the admin gets a clear alert with car, dates, and contact details — nothing slips through.

calendar.title: Clear fleet calendar
calendar.text: See all cars and bookings on one timeline. Spot free days, overlaps, and the week ahead without switching between spreadsheets.

move.title: Move bookings in a couple of clicks
move.text: Need to shift dates or switch the car? Drag bookings on the calendar — the schedule updates right away.

platform.title: One place for the whole workflow
platform.text: Orders, delivery zones, transfers, vouchers, and company contacts live in the same admin — less chaos, more control over the fleet.

alternativeOffer.pageTitle: The car you booked is not available
alternativeOffer.intro: The supplier has offered a replacement vehicle. Nothing about your booking changes until you decide — opening this page does not accept anything.
alternativeOffer.reasonTitle: Why the car is being replaced
alternativeOffer.priceGuarantee: A replacement can never cost more than the car you booked, and its class, transmission, seats and luggage capacity can never be worse.
alternativeOffer.acceptBodyUnpaid: Your booking continues with the replacement car at the price shown and moves on to payment as normal.
alternativeOffer.acceptBodyPaid: Your booking continues with the replacement car. What you have already paid carries over and nothing extra is charged for the change.
alternativeOffer.declineBodyPaid: Your booking is cancelled and the refund process starts. You are entitled to a full refund of your prepayment under the booking terms, or to a further replacement offer if you would rather have one.
alternativeOffer.declineBodyUnpaid: Your booking is cancelled. Nothing has been charged, so there is nothing to refund.
alternativeOffer.doNothingBody: The offer expires at the time shown above and can no longer be accepted. The same refund and replacement process applies as if you had declined.
alternativeOffer.confirmAcceptConsent: By confirming you consent to the replacement vehicle shown above.
alternativeOffer.acceptedBodyUnpaid: Your booking continues with the replacement car at the price shown. You will be guided through payment as normal, never for more than your original booking.
alternativeOffer.acceptedBodyPaid: Your booking continues with the replacement car. What you have already paid carries over and nothing extra is charged for the change.
alternativeOffer.declinedBodyRefund: Your booking is cancelled and the refund process has started.
alternativeOffer.declinedBodyNoPayment: Your booking is cancelled. Nothing was charged, so there is nothing to refund.
alternativeOffer.refundStep1: Your decision has been recorded and the supplier has been notified.
alternativeOffer.refundStep2: A full refund of your prepayment is prepared under the booking terms.
alternativeOffer.refundStep3: The refund is returned to the card or account you paid from. If you would prefer another replacement vehicle instead, contact us.
alternativeOffer.expiredBodyPaid: The offer expired without a decision, so it can no longer be accepted. Under the booking terms you are entitled to a full refund of your prepayment, or to a further replacement offer if you prefer one. Please contact us so we can arrange it.
alternativeOffer.expiredBodyUnpaid: The offer expired without a decision, so it can no longer be accepted. Nothing has been charged. Please contact us if you would like another replacement vehicle.
alternativeOffer.withdrawnBody: The supplier withdrew this replacement offer, so it can no longer be accepted. Please contact us about your booking.
alternativeOffer.alreadyRecorded: This offer had already been answered, so your earlier decision stands.
alternativeOffer.errorGeneric: We could not record your decision. Please try again.
alternativeOffer.errorRateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
alternativeOffer.supportNote: Questions about this offer? Contact us before the deadline and we will help.
